name: Silicon Box is an advanced chiplet packaging foundry, not an AI inference accelerator
symptom: Searching for Silicon Box AI inference accelerators or silicon compute specifications yields zero accelerator parts or TOPS numbers.
root_cause: Silicon Box (silicon-box.com) is an advanced semiconductor integration service provider and packaging foundry specializing in sub-5-micron panel-level packaging for chiplets. Founded by Marvell co-founders Dr. Byung-Joon Han and Sehat Sutardja, it manufactures and integrates chiplet packages designed by client companies, but does not design, manufacture, or market proprietary AI inference processors or compute silicon.
workaround: Do not create accelerator records for Silicon Box. Treat as a packaging ecosystem provider rather than an accelerator vendor.
notes: Verified against silicon-box.com/about on 2026-10-11. The company provides full execution from initial design to final manufacturing of chiplets, specialising in panel-level packaging integration.
